title: The lens in Wyze’s new $40 indoor camera retracts for privacy
summary: Wyze announced a new pan-and-tilt security camera today designed for indoor use. The entire Indoor Cam Pan can rotate 360 degrees, while the camera and lens on its front can tilt up and down 103 degrees.
